G01.note: Supply delay -> meager rations; quarreling contrasts a once cordial crew.

G02.note: Supermajorities make it arduous so the Constitution stays intact; C's malleable reverses the purpose.

G03.note: 'Conceded' plus decades of licensing fees signal a positive verdict: shrewd.

G04.note: Recounting the same crabs inflates the tally, so it suggested a robust population; migratory is the lure.

G05.note: 'Anything but' plus a small setting with emotional range points to insular; florid is consistent with spare prose but not the contrast.

G06.note: Never managed to find it -> inconspicuous; disappointing is weaker but not causal.

G07.note: Loyalty that vanished with a price rise was conditional.

G08.note: Seemingly random strings turned out to be a forty-year record: disjointed ... systematic.

G09.note: Dismissal reversed by learning every angle follows a strict rule -> capricious.

G10.note: Never departed from first principles -> consistent.

G11.note: Promising plan seems appealing; demolition makes residents indignant.

G12.note: Friends braced for disaster (scathing) but 'finest new writing' shows admiration.

G14.note: Weak, partial correlation with a concession -> tenuous at best.

G15.note: A veteran's slow starts read as decline; fast closing speed rebuts deterioration specifically.

G16.note: Narrow ruling leaving decisions to the council -> restrained.

G17.note: Friendship predicts evasiveness; 'yet ... candor' reverses it.

G18.note: Jokes -> genial; assistants rechecking figures -> fastidious.

G19.note: Each side quoting a different sentence as support -> equivocal.

G20.note: Drought makes allowances stringent; provisional clashes with the 'though' clause about duration.

G21.note: Exhaustive rehearsal lets concerts feel spontaneous, as if invented on the spot.

G22.note: Wording letting both sides claim no concession, 'rather than genuine settlement' -> cosmetic.

G23.note: 'So far from everything' -> remote; pricing out artists -> exorbitant.

G24.note: Pencil grids planning each drip refute haphazard.

G25.note: Crowded subplots -> sprawling; editors rarely change a word -> impeccable.

G26.note: Quiet but stops forty times per phrase -> unrelenting.

G27.note: Heard as insult but praises unhurried phrasing that lets music breathe -> languid.

G28.note: Critics see clashes as arbitrary; placement on turning words shows they are deliberate.

G29.note: Tempi carried in his head rather than on the page -> markings were cursory; idiosyncratic does not set up the contrast.

G30.note: Invisible repairs are contentious among conservators who now require visible repairs; C's esoteric does not follow.

G31.note: Precedent at every turn -> scrupulous; wildly different sentences -> erratic.

G32.note: Free trade except where it hurts them -> selective.

G33.note: No predators, never needed to flee -> unwary; insular is a topical lure.

G35.note: Seldom speaking -> taciturn; sharp constant commands -> assertiveness; B's exuberance fits less well.

G36.note: Faint glow drowned out -> drab; in darkness it becomes luminous.

G37.note: Borrowing freely -> imitative; unmistakably hers -> distinctive.

G38.note: Dreaded comments -> unsparing; checking every claim -> scrupulous.
